summary.intent: Fix broken CI load test workflow (staging secrets not resolving, wrong test runner flag), then run extended load tests at 10/20/30 clients to establish staging performance baselines, and push toward finding the concurrency ceiling of a single instance.
summary.outcome: CI workflow fixed and merged (PR #337), all three baseline runs completed with zero errors, results documented in `.planning/baselines/19-someguy-ipns-baselines.md`, and 50/75/100-client runs kicked off to probe capacity limits.

repo: GitHub environment-scoped secrets (`STAGING_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET`, `STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET`, `STAGING_API_URL`) require `environment: staging` on the job to be accessible — repository-level secrets do not need this.
The `environment:` field on a GitHub Actions job causes the UI to display 'Deploying to <env>' even when no actual deployment occurs — this is cosmetic only.
Required status checks on `main` had a stale entry (`Verify E2E Passed`) from a previous workflow; the new consolidated CI job is named `SDK E2E Tests` and needed to be explicitly added as required.
Staging scales near-linearly up to 30 clients: 2.7x throughput at 3x clients, p50 latency grows only 15-25%, zero errors — no saturation observed yet.
Baseline docs live in `.planning/baselines/` with a per-phase naming convention (e.g., `19-someguy-ipns-baselines.md`); format reference is `18-performance-baselines.md`.

code.finding: The `test:single` npm script used `--testPathPattern` (a Jest flag) instead of Vitest's positional file filter arg, causing the flag to be silently ignored by Vitest.
Load test job was missing `environment: staging`, causing all three staging env vars to be empty at runtime.

workflow: Vitest does not accept `--testPathPattern`; file filters are positional args. Passing `-- <pattern>` through an npm script puts args into CAC's separate bucket and does not filter files — use `pnpm exec vitest run --no-coverage <scenario>` directly in the workflow instead.
When consolidating/renaming CI workflows, required status check names on branch protection rules must be updated manually — GitHub does not auto-update them.
`gh run watch` output is just a summary; retrieving actual test step output requires a separate `gh run view --log` call filtered to the relevant step.

friction: `--testPathPattern` silently failed in Vitest, causing all 5 load test scenarios to run instead of just `mixed-workload` — wasted significant CI time across all three runs.
`gh run watch` didn't surface test output directly; required extra log-fetching steps to get actual results.
The stale `Verify E2E Passed` required check caused confusion when investigating why `SDK E2E Tests` wasn't listed as required.
The `environment: staging` label displaying 'Deploying to staging' in the GitHub UI was misleading and required explanation.
open_items: Fix scenario filtering bug: replace `pnpm test:single -- mixed-workload` in the load test workflow with `pnpm exec vitest run --no-coverage mixed-workload` to avoid CAC arg-bucket issue.
50/75/100-client runs were kicked off but results not yet captured in the transcript — baselines doc needs updating once those complete.
Determine the actual concurrency ceiling of a single staging instance based on 50/75/100-client results; may need to go higher if no saturation is observed.
Decision deferred: move staging secrets from the `staging` GitHub environment to repository-level to drop the `environment:` field and eliminate the misleading 'Deploying to staging' label.
